svg.title: Measure photovoltaic current–voltage characteristics
svg.desc: Source-linked conceptual operation. Unreported geometry and quantities are not reconstructed.

g.text: Photovoltaic characterization and distinct device cohorts
Generic method cue · no invented trace or specimen geometry
Inputs: Directly synthesized lead-iodide-passivated PbSe quantum dots
Keithley 2400 under simulated AM 1.5G illumination using a Newport Class AAA 94023A-U
simulator; calibrated with an Oriel 91150V reference cell and verified by a NREL-calibrated
Hamamatsu S1787-04 diode. SI literally specifies -1 to 0.1 V reverse and 0.1 to -1 V
forward sweeps; that range conflicts with the plotted main Figure 4c range.
Qualified action illustration; no unreported vessel dimensions, hardware, measured
molecular geometry, or experimental trace is implied.
Source: SI PDF p.7, Section 9, Measurement and characterization
